subject: Re-certification checkpoint, acceptance matrix & capacity onramp
messages:
From: Priyanka Rao <pri.rao@pinebridge-analytics.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@pinebridge-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 recert + renewal items (timeline and log retention)

Hi Diego —

Thanks for the quick onboarding help last quarter. Pinebridge is kicking off our renewal review and we need to confirm SOC 2 re-attestation scope and a few operational items to close procurement by mid-Oct. High level asks: 

- Can Redwood provide the most recent SOC 2 snapshot and a short acceptance matrix (what you will vs. what we need to test)
- We may need an audit log retention change to 180 days for our internal compliance — is that feasible and what are the carrier impacts?
- We anticipate increasing seats from 10 to ~18 as usage grows; we need an estimated onramp plan and timeline so we can include in the statement of work and purchase order.

Legal is asking for the evidence handoff method (S3 vs secured Drive) and a target attestation date. Do you have a short checklist you can share today?

Priyanka
Security and Compliance
Pinebridge Analytics

Attachments: none (they referenced their renewal packet in DocuSign)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Rao <pri.rao@pinebridge-analytics.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@pinebridge-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert + renewal items (timeline and log retention)

Priyanka —

Thanks for outlining this. We can absolutely support the requests; here is what I can share right away: 

1) SOC 2 snapshot and acceptance matrix
- Attached: soc2-snapshot-2026-09.pdf and acceptance-matrix-v1.xlsx. The matrix calls out which controls we assert, what artifacts Pinebridge should sample, and the timing for evidence collection.

2) Evidence handoff
- Preferred: an S3 bucket with pre-signed links (read-only) and short-lived tokens; we can provision and maintain ACLs. Alternative: Secure Drive folder with limited file-level access. Will confirm controls for data residency if needed.

3) Log retention change (180 days)
- Technical feasibility: yes. Impact: increased storage costs and slightly longer retrieval windows for forensic exports. We can offer a 60-day default and a scoped extension to 180 days as a purchasable add-on; estimate delta cost ~ +12% on audit/log storage for your current footprint.

4) Seat increase / capacity onramp
- Proposal: phased onramp over 6 weeks (10 -> 14 -> 18). We will allocate burst capacity in week 1 and reserve additional dedicated pool by week 4. Draft timeline in the attached acceptance-matrix-v1.xlsx.

Next steps: I’ll loop in our renewals lead and Solutions Engineer to produce a formal statement of work and cost delta. Could you confirm legal’s deadline for a signed amendment? If mid-Oct is firm, we’ll prioritize the DocuSign packet and evidence handoff.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0192

Attachments: soc2-snapshot-2026-09.pdf, acceptance-matrix-v1.xlsx

Team —

FYI: Pinebridge wants SOC 2 re-attestation and an audit log retention bump to 180 days. They’re planning to move seats 10 -> 18 and want an onramp timeline to include in procurement. Legal wants decisions by Oct 12. 

Quick asks for internal alignment: 
- Monica: can you validate the evidence handoff plan (S3 pre-signed links) and confirm staffing for evidence collection? We should offer a secure, auditable path and a minimal export checklist.
- Marcus: need quick estimate on storage delta and whether we can offer a 3-month promotional credit on the first billing period for storage uptick to ease procurement friction.
- Ben: are there capacity constraints to bump dedicated pool in ~4 weeks? Any change to SLA?

Proposed response: confirm S3 handoff, agree to 180-day retention as add-on, offer phased onramp with one-time credit for the first month of increased storage. If we get legal greenlight we’ll send an amendment (DocuSign) and schedule a kickoff with Solutions Engineering.

On Oct 12 I’ll send a decision record to Priyanka and CC renewals.

Thanks — Diego

Subject: Decision record & next steps — Pinebridge SOC 2 recert, 180d retention, seat onramp

Priyanka / Tom —

Thanks for the clarifications and the timeline. This email records our agreement and next steps so legal/procurement have a single source of truth. If anything below is incorrect please flag by EOD Oct 13.

Decision summary (agreed):
- Redwood will provide provider-uploaded evidence artifacts where feasible; each artifact will have a manifest entry (filename + SHA1 + timestamp).
- Evidence handoff method: dedicated S3 bucket with pre-signed, read-only links. Redwood will provide audit logs of access and a manifest CSV. (Attachment: log-sample-2026-09.csv shows format.)
- Retention: 180 days for audit logs as an add-on. Pricing delta: +12% on audit/log storage for Pinebridge’s current footprint. Marcus will issue a one-time credit covering the first billing period of the increased storage (details in acceptance-matrix-v1.xlsx).
- Seats/capacity onramp: target effective date Nov 1. Phased rollout: 10 -> 14 (week 1) -> 18 (week 4). We'll reserve burst capacity during initial weeks and convert to dedicated pool by week 4. Ben confirmed no SLA change; dedicated pool will carry the same SLOs.
- Legal/procurement path: Redwood will send an amendment (DocuSign: DS-99821) with the retention add-on and seat increase. Tom to circulate redlines; if no redlines by Oct 15 we’ll proceed to signature.

Deliverables and owners: 
- Acceptance matrix (attach v1) — Diego (done)
- Evidence bucket provisioning + manifest schema — Monica (provision by Oct 16)
- Pricing credit confirmation — Marcus (confirm by Oct 13)
- SOW & amendment / DocuSign packet — Diego & Renewals (packet ready Oct 13)
- Kickoff with Solutions Eng after signature; implementation window Nov 1–Nov 21.

Links and artifacts: acceptance-matrix-v1.xlsx, soc2-snapshot-2026-09.pdf, log-sample-2026-09.csv, Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-RENEWAL-PINEBRIDGE

Next steps for Pinebridge: please confirm by Oct 15 if the above is acceptable and return any redlines for the amendment. Once signed we’ll schedule the Nov 1 kickoff and begin evidence uploads.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.
